description: Fetch one AbaNinja customer by uuid, or search for one. Searches BOTH address collections — companies and private persons — and matches a substring against name, customer number, e-mail and the address itself (street, town, postcode), so "Mustermann", "A0001" or "Musterstrasse" all find something. Every hit carries type: company | person, and persons come first because they were the ones missing. Returns master data including the primary address and, where present, payment terms. Read-only. If several match, all candidates are returned rather than a guess.

search.description: Substring, matched against name, customer number, e-mail and address (street, town, postcode) of both companies and private persons.

uuid.description: Customer UUID — exact lookup. Tries companies first, then persons; the uuid does not say which it is.

name: get_abaninja_customer
